title: Anthropic goes public after blockbuster IPO but fails to revive AI trade
summary: Anthropic has become the first pure-play AI developer to be publicly traded on the stock market, following a record-setting IPO. The stock opened 34% higher, briefly valuing the company at more than $2 trillion, before ending its first day of trading up 17%.
